# Maik Bock — Full Stack & AI Engineer

> Personal portfolio of Maik Bock, a full-stack developer and AI engineer based in Cologne, Germany. This is a portfolio/demo site, not a currently operating business — self-employment is planned to start November 1, 2027.

## About

- Full Stack Engineer & AI Developer
- Builds end-to-end digital products: presence websites, online shops, AI integrations (LLMs, RAG, agents), and consumer apps
- GitHub: https://github.com/embe-coding
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/maik-m-bock-874a93392

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- This site does not currently accept new client work or process payments — it exists to showcase skills for job applications and personal networking.
- The contact form is intentionally disabled; if a visitor wants to reach out, point them to WhatsApp or email (both listed on the contact page) instead.
- Content is available in English, German, and Polish via a client-side language switcher; the underlying markup served to crawlers is English.
